metadata.objective: Add 100 independently auditable framework and QA-practice candidates to replenish the post-review survivor pool.
metadata.scoringScale: Each axis is scored from 0 to 10. Every survivor scores at least 8 on all four axes.
metadata.collisionPolicy: Reject exact, containing, or contained slugs; title token overlap above 60 percent; exact primary keyword ownership; same-searcher intent; and self-cannibalization.
metadata.sourcePolicy: Use 2 to 4 official framework, language, standards-body, or first-party project HTTPS sources per survivor.
metadata.independentAuditPolicy: Reject unsupported behavior, unsafe guidance, weak repository evidence, route or source mismatch, and topics unable to sustain an honest 3,000-word article.

sourceVerification.method: HTTP HEAD with redirect following and GET fallback for restricted HEAD responses
